openai.description: OpenAI GPT Image generation and editing

gpt-image-2.pricingNotes: Default registry rate is the published GPT Image 2 1024x1024 medium output-image estimate. Flexible size/quality estimates are handled in the OpenAI image pricing helper; image input units are modeled locally at 1,000 per reference image and priced only when imageInputCostPer1MCents is set; text input tokens are not estimated locally.

gpt-image-2.5-flare.description: GPT Image 2.5 Flare — fast everyday generation, reference-led variations, and editing
gpt-image-2.5-flare.pricingNotes: September 8 release (snapshot: gpt-image-2.5-flare-2026-09-08). Default output estimate: 439 tokens for 1024x1024 medium from the GPT Image 2.5 calculator in the image-generation guide, not the Image 2 table. Auto uses this provisional planning assumption. USD/M tokens: text input 5 (cached 1.25), image input 8 (cached 2), image output 30. Actual costs use returned usage at uncached rates; text output is not billed. Input estimates use 1,000 tokens per reference per output, exclude prompt tokens and cache discounts, and are not spending bounds. Latency inherits Image 2 provisionally; no paid calibration.

grok-imagine-image-2.0.description: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 — generation and editing with explicit low/medium quality

bytedance/seedream-5-pro.pricingNotes: Replicate lists 1K output at $0.045 and 2K output at $0.09 per image. The registry base rate is the 1K default; resolution-aware preflight selects the 2K rate when requested.
